Date: September 08, 2026 
 
To 
BSE Limited (‘BSE’) 
Listing Department 
Corporate Relationship Department               
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, 
2nd Floor, Dalal Street, 
Mumbai – 400 001 
BSE Script Code: 544866 
To 
National Stock Exchange of India Ltd 
Exchange Plaza, 
Bandra-Kurla Complex, 
Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 051 
Symbol: MOLBIO 
 
Subject: Audio Recording of Earnings Call for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
In continuation to the letter dated September 02, 2026, we wish to inform you that 
pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the Earnings Call held on 
September 08, 2026 in relation to the Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) of 
the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 has been made available on the website 
of the Company.  
 
The link for the same: www.molbiodiagnostics.com 
 
You are requested to kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thanking You. 
 
Yours Faithfully, 
 
For Molbio Diagnostics Limited 
 
 
 
Darshan Raghunath Karekar 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
M. No: F13569 
Place: Verna-Goa 
 
 
 
 
 
DARSHAN
